QuestionStmt.S: Identify neutral amino acid from following list represented by three letter symbols.

Solution.S:
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Three letter symbols} & \text{Amino acid} & \text{Type of amino acid} \\
\hline
\text{Trp} & \text{Tryptophan} & \text{Neutral} \\
\text{Arg} & \text{Arginine} & \text{Basic} \\
\text{Lys} & \text{Lysine} & \text{Basic} \\
\text{Glu} & \text{Glutamic acid} & \text{Acidic} \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

Among these options, Trp stands for Tryptophan, which is a neutral amino acid. Hence the correct option is A: Trp.
